This project will strengthen MER systems for FLR reporting in India, supporting transparent communication of FLR impacts to inform policy and practice. It aims to develop and refine monitoring and evaluation tools that accurately measure the ecological, economic, and social impacts of Forest Landscape Restoration (FLR) initiatives at various governance levels. The objective is to create monitoring systems, including protocols, measuring tools, guidelines, and frameworks, to generate reliable data that aids decision-makers in setting priorities, making informed decisions, and improving inter-departmental coordination. These systems will help report on national and international targets and commitments and be adaptable to the dynamic landscapes and diverse needs of FLR projects in India. it will incorporate existing monitoring tools and frameworks of key implementing partners at the state level, such as SFDs and other line departments, and national reporting mechanisms implemented by FSI and MoEFCC.
